root.label: Mark Walter agrees to sell Lakers shares

events.label: Mark Walter agrees to sell Lakers shares

slots.name: team valuation
slots.sentence: Just over a year after buying the Los Angeles Lakers at a record-setting valuation of $10 billion, Mark Walter agreed to sell the team to Bob Iger, the former Disney C.E.O., and Joshua Kushner, the brother of Trump’s son-in-law Jared, at a $12.5 billion valuation.

slots.name: Lakers ownership status
slots.sentence: The deal is for Walter’s shares in the Lakers and does not affect his ownership of the Dodgers or Sparks.
